terrain.access_rule: if the frozen registered-user acquisition cannot be completed before colour join, retain terrain as not_evaluable; never substitute another DEM after colour

grid.cell_identity: the frozen equal-area longitude by sin(latitude) grid from the atlas geometry
grid.neighbourhood: rook adjacency with longitude wrap; no distant nearest-cell repair when deriving an environmental boundary
grid.island_rule: a cell without a terrestrial rook neighbour is not_evaluable for that family

source_aggregation.macroclimate: area-weighted mean of every finite 10-minute WorldClim pixel whose centre lies in the equal-area cell; pixel area weight is cos(latitude)
source_aggregation.ecoregion: rasterize the official polygon ECO_ID to the WorldClim 10-minute grid by pixel centre, then take the cos(latitude)-weighted dominant ECO_ID within each equal-area cell; realm and biome follow that same dominant ECO_ID
source_aggregation.ecoregion_dbf_encoding: Windows-1252; the official archive has no .cpg, UTF-8 decoding stops before any grid output, and all 847 records decode under this fixed source-level setting
source_aggregation.coastal_rule: a cell is terrestrial for the climate-ecoregion freeze only when at least one pixel has both finite WorldClim values and a RESOLVE ECO_ID
source_aggregation.ties: choose the smallest numeric ECO_ID after exact weighted-area ties
source_aggregation.source_missingness: a primary family unavailable before the first colour join is frozen as not_evaluable; it is never replaced after colour

worldcover_sampling.inventory: freeze every object under the official v200/2021/map prefix with key, byte size, ETag and LastModified before sampling
worldcover_sampling.primary: read each 3 by 3 degree COG through its internal overview as a deterministic 60 by 60 nearest-neighbour categorical grid; use output-pixel centres and cos(latitude) area weights
worldcover_sampling.source_resolution_statement: the source classification is 10 m, but the frozen global composition estimator is an approximately 5 km systematic overview sample and must not be described as exhaustive 10 m aggregation
worldcover_sampling.composition: cos(latitude)-weighted proportions of the 11 official class codes within each equal-area cell
worldcover_sampling.sampling_sensitivity: repeat at 30 by 30 points per source tile; require Spearman correlation at least 0.9 between primary and sensitivity land-cover boundary intensity across common cells before the family is evaluable
worldcover_sampling.tile_rule: every frozen inventory tile must return a valid COG and only official class codes after retry; an unresolved tile makes the land-cover family not_evaluable

family_surfaces.macroclimate: standardize BIO1, BIO4, BIO12 and BIO15 across finite equal-area terrestrial cells; compute the RMS standardized difference on every terrestrial rook edge; a cell value is the mean of its incident edges
family_surfaces.terrain: apply the same frozen standardization and RMS edge rule to elevation, slope and terrain ruggedness
family_surfaces.land_cover: derive the 11-class composition in each equal-area cell; edge change is Hellinger distance and a cell value is the mean of incident edges
family_surfaces.ecoregion: primary edge change is one when dominant ecoregion differs and zero otherwise; realm and biome are frozen sensitivities

coverage_gate.failed_family_rule: retain not_evaluable and preserve its frozen denominator
coverage_gate.failed_branch_rule: if macroclimate or the two-family minimum fails, environmental concordance is not_evaluable

inference.flower_surface: opportunity-preserving equal-species mean of within-species ranked transition intensity
inference.method: the qualified weighted Moran eigenvector coefficient-sign randomization after frozen broad geographic detrending
inference.joint_maximum: one maximum statistic across all evaluable cohorts, scales, season sensitivities and primary environmental families

claim_ceiling: spatial concordance between automated flower-candidate colour transition intensity and independently frozen environmental transition intensity; not causation, adaptation or a universal boundary
